objective: Add a cheap read-only consistency check between canonical programme CURRENT_STATE_POINTER projections and their referenced programme-state records before expensive exact-head assurance.
checks: referenced state exists and is valid JSON
status agrees when both surfaces declare it
completed current packet is represented in completed_packets when that list exists
scope: canonical ovc-programme-current-state-pointer/v1 records under registries by default
failure_policy: BLOCK before expensive assurance; never mutate or repair programme state automatically
rollback: Remove the new preflight module/script/tests and required-assurance binding; preserve all programme-state history.
